title: ALMA Sub-arcsecond-resolution 183 GHz H<SUB>2</SUB>O and Dense Molecular Line Observations of Nearby Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxies
question: Investigate the properties of dense molecular gas tracers (HCN, HCO+, and HNC J=2-1) and 183 GHz H2O 3(1,3)-2(2,0) lines in the nuclei of ten nearby (ultra)luminous infrared galaxies with different levels of AGN energetic contributions.

what.value: IRAS 12, 25, 60, and 100 um fluxes for the target (U)LIRGs

evidence.quote: Col.(5)–(8): f$_{12}$, f$_{25}$, f$_{60}$, and f$_{100}$ are *IRAS* fluxes at 12 $\mu$m, 25 $\mu$m, 60 $\mu$m, and 100 $\mu$m, respectively, taken from (cite: kim98) or (cite: san03) or the IRAS Faint Source Catalog (FSC).

external_data.citation: (cite: kim98), (cite: san03), IRAS Faint Source Catalog (FSC)

what.value: Redshifts of the target (U)LIRGs adopted from ALMA dense molecular line data

evidence.quote: Col.(2): Redshift adopted from ALMA dense molecular line data (cite: ima16c), which are slightly different from the optically derived ones (cite: kim98) in some cases.

what.value: Arp 220 HC3N J=20-19 to HCN, HCO+, and HNC J=2-1 flux ratios measured with ~13 kpc beam

evidence.quote: Arp 220 data measured with $\sim$13 kpc beam (cite: gal16) are also added.

what.value: Previously obtained ALMA Band 6 and 7 continuum and spectral data for the serendipitous sources near IRAS 13509+0442 and the Superantennae

evidence.quote: For the northern source of IRAS 13509$+$0442, continuum detection ($>$25$\sigma$) was reported in ALMA band 6 (211–275 GHz) and 7 (275–373 GHz) data (cite: ima16c; ima18b), but no emission line signature was found in the obtained spectra.

what.value: Luminosity relations between infrared and J=4-3 lines of HCN and HCO+

evidence.loc: Emission Line Luminosity and Nuclear Dense Molecular Gas Mass
evidence.quote: The previously derived relations at J=4–3 (cite: zha14; tan18) are overplotted for reference.

recipe.goal: Continuum subtraction and imaging of continuum and spectral line cubes
recipe.method: Determine continuum level using line-free channels, subtract continuum in uv-plane with uvcontsub, and image line cubes (binned by 20 channels for ULIRGs and 10 channels for NGC 1614) and line-free continuum with CASA clean.
key_parameters: Briggs weighting, robust = 0.5, gain = 0.1; 20-channel binning (~35 km/s) for ULIRGs, 10-channel binning (~20 km/s) for NGC 1614; pixel scale 0.025''-0.1'' pixel^-1

recipe.goal: Create moment 0, 1, and 2 maps and measure deconvolved emission sizes
recipe.method: Integrate signals in channels with significant line detection to create moment 0, moment 1, and moment 2 maps at original beam resolution, and measure deconvolved intrinsic emission sizes on moment 0 and continuum maps using CASA task imfit.

recipe.goal: Smooth cubes to matched physical scales and extract nuclear spectra
recipe.method: Convolve data cubes to a common physical beam size (~1 kpc: 1.0, 1.2, or 1.6 kpc for ULIRGs; 200 pc and 1 kpc for NGC 1614; and 2 kpc for ULIRGs) using CASA task imsmooth, and extract spectra at continuum peak positions.
key_parameters: Target beam sizes: 1 kpc (or 1.2 kpc for IRAS 12112+0305 and IRAS 15250+3609; 1.6 kpc for IRAS 06035-7102), 200 pc and 1 kpc for NGC 1614, and 2 kpc for ULIRGs

recipe.goal: Fit Gaussian profiles to spectral lines and compute line flux ratios
recipe.method: Fit single or double Gaussian profiles to extracted spectra at original, ~1 kpc, 2 kpc, and 200 pc beams to measure velocity-integrated fluxes, and calculate flux ratios among HCN, HCO+, HNC J=2-1, 183 GHz H2O, HC3N, and CS lines.

recipe.goal: Derive line luminosities, nuclear dense molecular gas masses, and gas depletion times
recipe.method: Convert ~1kpc-beam velocity-integrated line fluxes to L_line (L_sun) and L'_line (K km s^-1 pc^2) using Solomon & Vanden Bout (2005) equations, derive dense gas mass M_dense from HCO+ J=2-1 luminosity, and compute lower limits on gas depletion time t_dep = M_dense / SFR.
key_parameters: H0 = 71 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_M = 0.27, Omega_Lambda = 0.73
assumptions: HCO+ emission is thermalized and optically thick at J=2-1 and J=1-0; conversion factor alpha_HCO+ = 2-5 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1; SFR (M_sun yr^-1) = 4.5 x 10^-44 L_IR (erg s^-1)

score_reason: Observing log, calibrators, continuum frequency windows, weighting (Briggs robust=0.5), channel binning, smoothed physical beam sizes, peak coordinates, and Gaussian fit parameters are all thoroughly tabulated; minor imaging and moment-integration parameters (exact velocity windows, clean thresholds, CASA version) are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: Both ALMA Cycle 5 datasets (2017.1.00022.S and 2017.1.00023.S) are public in the ALMA archive, the data reduction uses standard pipeline calibration plus straightforward CASA tasks (uvcontsub, clean, imsmooth, imfit), and all intermediate and final numeric measurements (continuum fluxes, Gaussian line fits at multiple physical apertures, deconvolved sizes, luminosities, and gas masses) are comprehensively tabulated.
